title: rubus suberectus subsp. plicatus
intro: Rubus suberectus subsp. plicatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan strawberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rubus genus of bramble fruits. It is rich in various nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which may include protecting against cell damage, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Rubus suberectus subsp. plicatus may also include cardiovascular protection, anti-cancer effects, and wound healing properties, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
